name: Icon of Khan Maraudos procs Rage of Maurados on melee or ranged damage (#10583)
contract: Icon of Khan Maraudos (item 354206) equips the proc dummy 304120, which triggers Rage of Maurados (304121). Its DBC record carries ProcFlags 0 and ProcChance 10, and the world had no spell_proc row, so the aura never registered a proc handler and the trinket never procced while the reporter hit target dummies.

The tooltip reads: dealing damage with Melee or Ranged attacks has a chance to increase Attack Power and Critical Strike Rating. The expected proc events are therefore landed melee and ranged auto attacks and landed melee or ranged damage-class spells, at the DBC ProcChance of 10%.

The loaded proc entry is asserted directly: spell_proc_chance reads 10, and a landed melee auto attack, a ranged auto attack and a melee damage-class spell hit each proc the equipped dummy at about 10%. A magic damage-class spell hit, a periodic tick and an unlanded cast-phase event proc it zero times. Before the repair the dummy has no proc entry, so the chance lookup fails.
A trinket-less control carries no dummy aura.

steps.label: SETUP: equipping applies the proc dummy aura
CONTROL: a trinket-less player carries no dummy aura
DISCRIMINATING: the loaded proc entry carries the DBC 10% chance
DISCRIMINATING: a landed melee auto attack procs at about 10%
DISCRIMINATING: a landed ranged auto attack procs at about 10%
DISCRIMINATING: a landed melee damage-class spell hit procs at about 10%
CONTROL: a magic damage-class spell hit is not a melee or ranged attack
CONTROL: a periodic tick is not a melee or ranged attack
CONTROL: an unlanded cast-phase melee spell event is not a proc event
